The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect instruction. The generated output explicitly repeats the error, stating 'Keep the lattice vectors fixed during relaxation' and even more directly, 'Perform a variable-cell relaxation calculation but hold the cell vectors constant', which is a logical contradiction.
